{{Quote|It's on my datapad. It's twenty years old&hellip;but the navy doesn't have it, so they won't know that.|Garik Loran about Jabbeer Six|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Jabbeer Six''' was an application developed to scan unclassified reports for embedded language used to convey secret information to enemy [[Spy/Legends|spies]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wraith Squadron]] leader [[Garik Loran]] traded Jabbeer Six to [[Davian]], naval [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], in exchange for granting him access to restricted Alliance files.<ref name="MK" />
